JavaScript.title: Modern JavaScript from the Beginning (ES6+ & Async/Await)
JavaScript.description: Master ES6 syntax, Closures, Promises, Async/Await, and Event Loop internals.
JavaScript.practicalExercise: Build a responsive Currency Exchange converter utilizing fetch API and async error handling.

JavaScript.title: Deep JavaScript Foundations & V8 Engine Internals
JavaScript.description: Scope, hoisting, prototypes, coercion, and garbage collection mechanisms in browser engines.
JavaScript.practicalExercise: Implement a custom Promise polyfill supporting .then(), .catch(), and Promise.all().

React.title: React 19 & Component Architecture Masterclass
React.description: Functional components, custom hooks, useEffect lifecycle, state management, and component composition.
React.practicalExercise: Construct an interactive Task Kanban Board with drag-and-drop state persistence.

React.title: Scalable State Management & Performance Optimization
React.description: Context API patterns, useReducer architectures, memoization (useMemo/useCallback), and lazy loading.
React.practicalExercise: Refactor a heavy table dashboard with virtualized scrolling and memoized component tree.

Node.js.title: Node.js Backend Architecture & RESTful API Engineering
Node.js.description: Event-driven architecture, EventEmitter, streams, file system I/O, Express routing, and middleware patterns.
Node.js.practicalExercise: Architect an authenticated e-commerce REST API with JWT security and input validation.

Node.js.title: Microservices, Database Integration & Async Concurrency
Node.js.description: Connection pooling, PostgreSQL/MongoDB drivers, worker threads, rate limiting, and structured logging.
Node.js.practicalExercise: Build a real-time event streaming service with WebSocket and database audit logging.

HTML & CSS.title: Modern Semantic HTML5, CSS Grid & Flexbox Mastery
HTML & CSS.description: Semantic markup, accessibility (a11y), responsive viewport units, and modern flex/grid layouts.
HTML & CSS.practicalExercise: Create an accessible responsive pricing table with WCAG AAA contrast and keyboard navigation.

SQL.title: Relational Database Design, Indexing & Complex Joins
SQL.description: Normalization (1NF-3NF), multi-table joins, subqueries, indexing strategies, and transaction ACID properties.
SQL.practicalExercise: Design an online booking database schema and write analytical queries for monthly active users.

Python.title: Python for Software Engineering & API Services
Python.description: OOP design patterns, decorators, generators, unit testing with pytest, and async asyncio.
Python.practicalExercise: Build a background log parser and metrics aggregation CLI tool.

Git & Version Control.title: Professional Git Workflows, Branching Strategies & PRs
Git & Version Control.description: Interactive rebase, cherry-pick, merge conflict resolution, and trunk-based development.
Git & Version Control.practicalExercise: Simulate a multi-contributor repo merge conflict and resolve it via terminal rebase.

REST APIs.title: RESTful API Best Practices, HTTP Semantics & Security
REST APIs.description: Status codes, idempotent methods, rate limiting, OpenAPI 3.0 specs, and OWASP Top 10 API security.
REST APIs.practicalExercise: Document a full CRUD API using Swagger/OpenAPI spec and write automated contract tests.
